sayLines.line: Priya is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.

◈ FLASHBACK — Reading Glasses
You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Jacob next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.
Field medicine on Aroha: clean the wound, poultice it, bind it right — the sickness has nowhere left to stand. Aroha is going to make it. (Priya cured them — and the camp saw it.)

Deeper knowledge: Purslane. Uses: highest omega-3 of any leafy plant. Good raw in summer heat. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: succulent crunch, surprisingly rich — eat fresh; medicine: cooling poultice for minor burns.
🧭 Oliver is back from the north. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
🧭 Lorena is back from the east. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
🧭 Wei is back from the east. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
(Learned: Haven can REQUEST aid from linked villages — food, medicine, hands. Find it on the Haven panel, under your links.)
Lorena came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)

📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 2). You know dosages, preparations, contraindications. This is real medicine, just old.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Pattern Recognition, Ambush, Herbal Medicine. Your Codex overflows.
